subject: bug in comparison operator code generation

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: bug in comparison operator code generation
parts:
In release 1.1.0, the comparison operators are compiled
to the wrong targets. Specifically, > is compiled to >=
and vice-versa and < to <= and vice-versa.

I just pushed a patch to the trunk on git.

This motivate us to get the next version out ASAP.

Until then, there's not really a good workaround.

(This one's all my fault -- I had to rearrange the
order to deal with Boost Spirit's greedy parsing
strategy, but I forgot to take the semantic actions
along with the operator literals.)

- Bob
